detail.longDescription: I (well my agent swarm) created this in the last 48 hours based on method in a research paper I found ( https://www.mdpi.com/2072-4292/13/15/3016 ) for detecting flying craft from OSINT Sentinel 2 satellite imagery from the European space agency. There's something about the pixelated detections from images coming off the satellite.. I discussed the build in another post: https://fmsg.ai/blog/agent-swarm-ufo-optix
